_comment: Freshness policy: how long each kind of knowledge stays valid. Edit this file — no code needed. Everything older than its TTL is excluded from a pack (and listed as risk in the report).

freshness._comment: score = 1 at age 0, 0 at age = TTL. Linear decay, so an auditor can recompute it.

duplicates._comment: Exact duplicates are found by content hash; near duplicates by token Jaccard similarity.

conflicts._comment: Same entity key with different values across sources. Conflicts are NEVER auto-resolved: they go to a human queue.
